news.title: Temporary Store Closure | 27 October – 15 November 2026
news.excerpt: Our online store is temporarily closed from 27 October to 15 November 2026. Orders will resume from 16 November, while our free online guitar wiring tools remain available throughout.
news.body:
# Temporary Store Closure | 27 October – 15 November 2026

Our online store is temporarily closed from **27 October to 15 November 2026**, with normal operations resuming on **Monday, 16 November 2026**.

During this period, we will not be processing or dispatching new orders.

## Our Online Tools Remain Available

Although the store is temporarily closed, our online guitar wiring tools and resources will remain available throughout.

You can continue to explore our wiring diagrams, experiment with different electronics configurations, and plan your next guitar project.

## Returning on 16 November

We look forward to reopening on **Monday, 16 November 2026**, when normal order processing and dispatch will resume.

Thank you for your patience, understanding and continued support of Apparition Instruments.

**The Apparition Instruments Workshop**

news.title: Workshop closed 12–13 October
news.excerpt: The Apparition workshop will be closed on 12 and 13 October while we get married. Normal service resumes shortly afterwards.
news.body:
The Apparition Instruments workshop will be closed on 12 and 13 October while we take a couple of days away to get married!  
The website, Luthier Hub and interactive tools will remain available as normal. Orders and enquiries received around the closure may take a little longer to process.  
Normal service will resume shortly afterwards. Thanks for your patience!
